bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge BigBang
bricks.description: Independent Editor installer: prepare required libraries and Steamworks.NET, verify God installation and hand off. BigCrunch separately reviews and confirms whole-Forge removal; game content and third-party libraries are retained.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Commandments Compatibility
bricks.description: Legacy Companion API adapter forwarding to God. For existing integrations only; offers no independent documentation viewer or updater.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge God
bricks.description: Required foundation for brick lifecycle, shared services, retained bootstrap, package management and Editor-only Commandments tools. Does not require optional peer bricks.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Steam
bricks.description: Optional Windows x64 Steam platform provider and release preparation, separate from Multiplayer's required built-in Steam networking. Local development starts without native Steam. Native account, overlay and depot acceptance remain unverified.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Multiplayer
bricks.description: Planned and unavailable: Client-Host multiplayer using FishNet with required built-in FishySteamworks/Steamworks.NET support. Steam networking is part of this kit, not an optional separate kit. Local Tugboat testing does not verify Steam. No implementation, install source or compatibility profile is published.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Diagnostics
bricks.description: Optional game diagnostics: logs, health checks, inspected values, session history, commands and Windows metrics. Runtime console installation is a separate opt-in action.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Angels
bricks.description: Optional Editor tools for project organization, reviewed naming, sorting and game-design document import. Paid Codex/audio analysis requires explicit setup and consent; scans preserve completed work on cancellation.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Settings System
bricks.description: Game settings with authored panels, typed providers, reviewed Stage/Apply/Cancel and local persistence. Supports built-in sound controls and optional Audio/UI integrations; game-specific settings use public provider APIs.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Scene Loading and Bootstrap
bricks.description: Additive scene destinations, retained bootstrap, readiness and transition presentation. Use for content replacement without unloading bootstrap; optional pool cooperation does not add a peer dependency.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Save and Load
bricks.description: Local gameplay saves with profiles, named slots, explicit participants, bounded atomic files and transactional restore. Includes no-code bindings and code extensions; cloud and network transport remain outside this module.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Audio
bricks.description: Game sound playback using built-in Unity audio by default, with owned handles, mixing and reusable authoring. FMOD is optional; listening, device and native-backend acceptance remain separate.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge User Interface Foundations
bricks.description: UI Toolkit menu/screen authoring, typed game actions, navigation and shared appearance. New hosts use PanelRenderer; existing UIDocument setups remain supported without automatic conversion.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Object Pooling
bricks.description: Reusable prefab pooling with bounded growth, prewarming, generation-bound leases and explicit reset/return ownership. Game adapters retain responsibility for their object lifetimes.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge GitFlow
bricks.description: Editor-only read-only queue, lease, processor and receipt viewer. Refresh is explicit; it cannot submit, publish, retry or recover work. Supports public HTTPS and absolute local remotes.
